content: To know oneself is to understand the boundaries of one's power and the depth of one's responsibility.
author: Socrates
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. From childhood, we are trained to fit in, to smooth over our eccentricities, and to mirror the expectations of those around us. But copying others only buys superficial acceptance at the cost of your own soul.

Socrates understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Your unique perspective and lived contradictions are your greatest offering to the world. The moment you stop performing and stand firmly in your own skin, you command an authority that imitation can never manufacture.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
